A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, Table 1, Figures 1–2, and complete Appendices A–F are readable and support comparison.

before.justification: Section 6 and Figures 1–2 report original simulations of discounted and average-reward TD on a modified Boyan chain, averaged over 10 runs. Appendix F documents the environment.

after.justification: V2 retains the work's original simulation results in Figures 1–2 and their experimental documentation in Section 6 and Appendix F.

M1.justification: The discounted and average-reward TD(λ) update rules, eligibility traces, and analytical constructions are retained. The learning-rate revision concerns the experimental setup rather than a newly proposed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 15-state, five-action Boyan-chain variant with the same rank-three feature matrix, discounted and average-reward tasks, and eligibility-trace settings. Appendix F's environment and feature matrix are unchanged.

E2.justification: Neither version adds or removes an empirically evaluated comparator; the figures compare TD parameter settings. Table 1 retains the same theoretical comparisons, including the same work relabeled from Chen et al. [2023b] to Chen et al. [2025a].

E3.justification: Section 6 changes both experiments from explicitly constant learning rates to diminishing rates divided by t+t0, specifying ξ=1 and t0=10^7. This substantially revises the reported learning-rate regime. The environment, plotted coefficient values, and 1.5 million-step budget remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Both retain the same learning-rate and eligibility-trace parameter sweeps. No new ablation, robustness test, error analysis, or case study appears in the main text or appendices.

E5.justification: Both figure captions report averages over 10 runs with shaded standard errors, described as too small to see. Appendix F retains the same run count, with no added seed information or statistical procedure.

E6.justification: Figures 1–2 retain identical plotting content, parameter labels, and convergence trends. Section 6 retains the same qualitative finding of convergence toward the solution set. The revised protocol description does not provide new numerical outcomes or establish a comparable performance change.

T1.justification: Theorems 1–2 now explicitly specify κ1=αC7 and κ2=αC10, and Section 3 gives the sufficiently-large-α, ξ=1 specialization yielding O(log t/t). These are limited refinements; the general bounds, assumptions, and proofs in Appendices A–E remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the central claims: first L2 convergence rates for linear TD(λ) with arbitrary features in both reward settings, without algorithmic modifications, using convergence to a solution set and the feature decomposition.

C2.justification: V2 explicitly interprets its rate as matching analyses with independent features, remarks that Lemma 5 could support constant-step-size analysis, and proposes Polyak–Ruppert averaging for potentially parameter-free rates. The existing limitations concerning linear approximation and other convergence modes remain.

D1.justification: Section 6 adds the explicit schedule offset t0=10^7 and exponent ξ=1 alongside its revised learning-rate description. Appendix F retains the same transitions, rewards, feature matrix, computational budget, AMD processor, and approximate one-minute runtime.

R1.justification: V2 adds Patil et al. [2023] and Naskar et al. [2024] for the averaging direction and explicitly positions its convergence rate against Bhandari et al. [2018] and Srikant and Ying [2019]. Most other citation changes update metadata for existing works.

P1.justification: V2 adds localized explanatory passages in Sections 3–4 and 7, revises the experimental paragraph, corrects citation metadata, and updates the conference footer and funding acknowledgments. The section organization and appendix structure are retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 reorders the bibliographically updated Chen entry, while added text shifts the figures relative to surrounding text and changes page breaks. Figures 1–2 retain the same panels, axes, legends, captions, and plotting graphics.

improvement.justification: V2 improves the explanation of the convergence rate and its relationship to prior analyses. However, Section 6 replaces constant rates with diminishing rates and t0=10^7 while retaining identical curves and coefficient labels, without explaining whether this corrects the earlier description or reflects different experiments. This unresolved relationship between the reported protocol and results prevents a reliable judgment of net quality improvement.
